mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jxc_stock (product_id, batch_no, production_date, expiry_date, quantity, cost_price, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{productId}, #{batchNo}, #{productionDate}, #{expiryDate}, #{quantity}, #{costPrice}, #{operName}, sysdate(), #{operName}, sysdate()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + #{quantity}, cost_price = #{costPrice}, production_date = IFNULL(#{productionDate}, production_date), expiry_date = IFNULL(#{expiryDate}, expiry_date), update_by = #{operName}, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: SELECT quantity FROM jxc_stock WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jxc_stock_flow (product_id, batch_no, flow_type, biz_type, biz_id, biz_item_id, biz_no, change_qty, balance_qty, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{productId}, #{batchNo}, #{flowType}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{bizItemId}, #{bizNo}, #{changeQty}, #{balanceQty}, #{operName}, sysdate(), #{remark})

INSERT INTO jxc_payable (supplier_id, source_no, source_type, amount, paid_amount, balance, status, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{supplierId}, #{sourceNo}, #{sourceType}, #{amount}, 0.00, #{amount}, '0', #{operName}, sysdate(), #{remark})

INSERT INTO jxc_receivable (member_id, source_no, source_type, amount, received_amount, balance, status, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{sourceNo}, #{sourceType}, #{amount}, 0.00, #{amount}, '0', #{operName}, sysdate(), #{remark})
